info.title: Smart Environment Simulator
info.description: API local. Estimación analítica; sin garantía de precisión experimental.

post.description: Queue a map; poll it with GET and stop it with DELETE.
Bounded exhaustive comparison of allowed AP places; synchronous because it is capped.

get.description: Generic radio profiles with per-value provenance; approximations, not products.

post.description: Nominal, best and worst cases of unresolved doors/materials, plus named scenarios.
Per-link report of computed values, hypotheses and missing data; no coverage verdict.
Validate a local measurement campaign and, with its project, compare it with predictions.

MapGrid-Input.title: MapGrid
MapGrid-Input.description:
Horizontal sampling plane. Cell (i, j) is evaluated at its centre:
x = origin_x_m + (i + 0.5)·resolution_m, y = origin_y_m + (j + 0.5)·resolution_m, z = height_m.
Edge cells narrower than resolution_m use the centre of their clipped extent.

MapGrid-Output.title: MapGrid
MapGrid-Output.description:
Horizontal sampling plane. Cell (i, j) is evaluated at its centre:
x = origin_x_m + (i + 0.5)·resolution_m, y = origin_y_m + (j + 0.5)·resolution_m, z = height_m.
Edge cells narrower than resolution_m use the centre of their clipped extent.

PlanReference-Input.title: PlanReference
PlanReference-Input.description:
Background floor-plan image placed at scale; display aid only, never a solver input.

The image stays a local file: only its fingerprint travels in the project. Pixel (u, v),
u to the right and v downwards from the top-left corner, maps to
x = origin_x_m + u·meters_per_pixel and y = origin_y_m + v·meters_per_pixel.
